title: Tomorrow's weather
instructions: Radyoda yarının hava durumu. Saatleri, bölgeleri ve sıcaklıkları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Here is the weather for tomorrow.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In the morning, it will be cold and cloudy, about eight degrees.

script.speaker: s
script.text: At lunchtime, it will start to rain in the north.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In the south, it will be sunny all day, and it will be warmer, about fifteen degrees.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In the evening, there will be strong winds near the sea.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On Sunday, it will be sunny everywhere.

questions.feedback: Sabah soğuk ve bulutlu, yaklaşık sekiz derece.
